title: Rebuild
intro: Cutting down a behaviour opens up a gap. Filling that gap with routines that are good for you makes the change last.

planner.title: Alternatives for your risky hours
planner.hint: Choose 1–2 alternative activities for each of your risky time ranges.
planner.empty: First choose your risky hours on the Environment and digital boundaries screen or during sign-up.

sleep.title: Sleep hygiene
sleep.note: General information; not medical treatment. If your sleep problem lasts a long time, see a doctor.

items.label: I go to bed and get up at similar times every day
I leave my phone outside the bedroom
I turn off screens 30 minutes before bed
My room is dark, quiet and cool
I cut down on caffeine in the afternoon
If I can't sleep, I get up and do something calm in dim light

connection.title: Weekly connection task
connection.doneNote: Great. Connection meets the need underneath the urge.
tasks: Call someone in your family and ask how they are.
Join a community activity (sport, a course, volunteering).
Message someone you haven't talked to in a long time.

bridge.title: Tools in the app
bridge.hint: Taking good care of your body is part of rebuilding too.
